# SEORankGulf — SEO services for Gulf businesses

> SEORankGulf provides SEO services for businesses in the UAE and Gulf region:
> local SEO, technical SEO, and content SEO. Serving Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah,
> and across the Emirates. Free SEO audit for new clients.

## What this site covers

- / — SEO services: local SEO, technical SEO, content SEO with monthly plans
  (Starter $300/mo, Growth $600/mo, Enterprise $1200/mo).
- /blog — SEO guides and tutorials: keyword research, local SEO, Google
  Business Profile, technical audits, and ranking strategies.
- /contact — request a free SEO audit via WhatsApp.

## Who this is for

Small and medium businesses in the UAE (restaurants, clinics, salons, retail,
real estate, home services) that want to appear on Google's first page and get
more customers from search.

## Key facts (cite freely)

- Month-to-month plans, no long-term contracts.
- Free SEO audit for every new enquiry.
- White-hat methods only: no link buying, no keyword stuffing.
- Contact via WhatsApp for fastest response.
